args.question: It looks like your claim submission came through without any of the core details we need. Could you please provide: your policy number, your full name, the type of claim (e.g., auto, property, medical), the date of the incident, the date you're reporting it, a description of what happened, an itemized list of costs/damages, and the total amount you're claiming?
args.reasoning: Every substantive field in the extracted claim data is null — there is no claim type, policy ID, claimant identity, incident date/description, line items, or claimed amount. Only the supporting_documents booleans are populated (all false), which on their own aren't actionable without knowing what the claim is even about. This isn't an arithmetic mismatch or a sign of manipulation (the arithmetic check itself returned None/None because there were no line items to check) — it's simply an incomplete submission that the claimant is best positioned to fill in themselves, so a clarifying question is the right next step rather than escalation or approval.
